title: Definitions
previewText:
Definitions specifically applicable to the Northern Hunters Point Waterfront Access Plan are set forth in this Section. Other defined terms are set forth in Section 117-01 and Section 12-10. In addition, for the purposes of Section 117-36, inclusive, the definition of development shall be as set forth in Section 62-11 (Definitions).

blocks.plainText: For the purposes of this Chapter, “active recreation space” shall mean a designated area outdoors designed and equipped for recreational activities that involve physical movement, exercise, sports or play. These spaces accommodate a wide range of dynamic uses and may include, but are not limited to:

blocks.html:
1. sports courts, such as tennis, basketball, volleyball, pickleball or ping pong courts;
  2. athletic fields, such as baseball, football, soccer, cricket, rugby or lacrosse fields;
  3. water-based recreation, such as splash parks, sprinkler parks or swimming pools;
  4. water access and interaction space, such as boat and kayak launches or urban beaches;
  5. adventure and skill-based activities, such as skate parks, climbing walls or obstacle courses;
  6. social and leisure games, such as bocce, shuffleboard, mini golf or horseshoe pits; 
  7. fitness facilities, such as outdoor gyms or yoga areas, exercise circuits or jogging tracks;
  8. play spaces, such as playgrounds, tot lots or adventure playgrounds; or
  9. community and cultural spaces, such as open-air amphitheaters, performance stages or gathering lawns.
